hold_text: PROP-EXEC lane brief (manager session_01HYq6XtfesZ57VyaQrK6CL1): every PR in this lane is held; the manager merges after independent review. Do not arm auto-merge.
why: PI-20260929-2PNSPDNU-0005: three ticks after go-live (2026-09-29 18:44:39Z) the executor latched AUTO-REVERT on nothing. The day's two test round trips had ledgered their unconfirmed CLOSE as state 'unconfirmed' — the same word the reconcile reads as an unconfirmed SUBMIT — while the venue had long closed both positions; three re-reads found nothing and 'unconfirmed placement' tripped the halt. Fix: a watched close that did not confirm is ledgered close_unconfirmed (IntentLedger.CLOSE_UNRESOLVED): a later close-out still links to it, the reconcile never counts it as a submit. Regression test replays the go-live case (a stale close_unconfirmed row and a real unconfirmed submit side by side: only the submit trips). Tier 2: executor ledger semantics on the live path; no click, sizing or guard change.
